description: Source code for the Android AudioPlayer class implementing audio playback functionality, including start, pause, reset, seek, and callback handling.

classes.name: AudioPlayer
classes.description: Class managing audio playback, including source setup, buffer handling, and playback controls.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts audio playback, setting up audio sink or track based on configuration.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses playback, optionally playing pending samples.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the player, stopping and releasing resources, preparing for new playback.

methods.name: seekTo
methods.description: Seeks to specified position in the audio stream.

methods.name: reachedEOS
methods.description: Checks if end of stream has been reached.

methods.name: setPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate for audio.

methods.name: fillBuffer
methods.description: Fills the output buffer with audio data from the source.

methods.name: getOutputPlayPositionUs_l
methods.description: Calculates current playback position in microseconds.
